text: Rearrange the letters of HARE to make a word meaning 'listen to'.
Take one letter out of STARLING to make a word meaning 'looking hard'.
why: Drop the L: STARLING becomes STARING.

text: A diving gannet hits 60 miles an hour. At that speed, how many miles would it cover in 5 minutes?
why: 60 mph is a mile a minute, so 5 minutes is 5 miles.

text: A barn owl lays an egg every other day. The first comes on a Monday. On which day does the fifth arrive?
A hare runs a hundred metres at 10 metres a second but naps for a minute halfway. A tortoise plods it at 1 metre a second. By how many seconds does the hare win?
A field holds deer and pheasants: 20 heads and 56 legs in all. How many deer are there?
why: If all 20 were pheasants that's 40 legs; the 16 extra legs are 2 per deer, so 8 deer.

text: How many letters of the alphabet never appear in the word OYSTERCATCHER?
why: It uses only nine different letters (O, Y, S, T, E, R, C, A, H); 26 − 9 = 17.
